title: a Check line of the form git diff --stat -- PATH should also list untracked files, or the spec template should use git status --short PATH

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on slicer in ork run ork-20261117-233555-6d1c, project ork, item S390:

a Check line of the form git diff --stat -- PATH should also list untracked files, or the spec template should use git status --short PATH

Evidence: S390 Check expects git diff --stat -- testdata/golden to list two new goldens, but untracked files never appear in git diff, so the line prints nothing even when correct
